claim_policy: Numerical tests validate implementations and stated identities only; they do not establish new physical laws or solve Millennium Prize Problems.

claims.statement: For nonzero integer n, digital_root(n) equals 1 + (abs(n)-1) mod 9; digital_root(0)=0.
vortex_transform preserves input radius up to radial_scale.
The smooth field (-y/(x^2+y^2+epsilon), x/(x^2+y^2+epsilon)) has zero divergence analytically away from invalid epsilon; finite differences check implementation behavior.
Central finite-difference operators approximate divergence, curl, and Laplacian.
